_comment: Draft only. This is written by hand as the JSON shape the Dynatrace platform dashboard editor exports (dashboardMetadata plus a tiles array of DQL query tiles), not exported from a real tenant, since no tenant exists yet (docs/proposals/dynatrace.md). The wrapper (dashboardMetadata, bounds, tileType, queries[].id) may need adjusting on import; each tile's query and its 'reliesOn' note are the deliverable. Queries assume the agent's per-run JSON record (agent/src/guppi_agent/app.py) reaches Grail as log events with its keys as top-level fields, which is how Dynatrace's automatic JSON log parsing behaves on well-formed JSON content once the Firehose log forwarding in docs/proposals/dynatrace.md is set up; none of this was verified against a real tenant.

tiles.name: Runs per hour
tiles.reliesOn: The agent's per-run record, field run (agent/src/guppi_agent/app.py)

queries.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(run)
| summarize count(), by: bin(timestamp, 1h)

tiles.name: First delta latency p50/p90
tiles.reliesOn: The agent's per-run record, field first_delta_ms (record["first_delta_ms"] set in agent/src/guppi_agent/app.py's event_stream)

queries.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(first_delta_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(first_delta_ms, 50), p90 = percentile(first_delta_ms, 90), by: bin(timestamp, 1h)

tiles.name: Run outcome split
tiles.reliesOn: The agent's per-run record, field outcome (finished, error, client_disconnected)

queries.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(outcome)
| summarize count(), by: outcome

tiles.name: Retrieval rate
tiles.reliesOn: The agent's per-run record, field tool_calls (incremented once per Retrieve/AgenticRetrieveStream call in run_agent)

queries.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(run)
| summarize withRetrieval = countIf(tool_calls > 0), runs = count()
| fields retrievalRatePct = withRetrieval * 100.0 / runs

tiles.name: Token usage
tiles.reliesOn: The agent's per-run record, fields input_tokens and output_tokens (StrandsRun.usage in agent/src/guppi_agent/agent.py)

queries.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(input_tokens)
| summarize input = sum(input_tokens), output = sum(output_tokens), by: bin(timestamp, 1h)

tiles.name: Feedback up/down ratio
tiles.reliesOn: The RUM custom action reply-feedback and its vote property (web/src/rum.js buildFeedbackActionProperties, docs/proposals/feedback.md). Least certain of the eight: the Grail table and field names for a RUM custom action's properties were not confirmed against a real tenant; adjust the fetch source and action.properties.vote path against what a real reply-feedback action looks like once RUM is live.

tiles.name: WAF counts
tiles.reliesOn: CloudWatch metrics WafBlocks, WafFailCloses, WafFailOpens in namespace AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore, dimension GatewayId (infra/guppi_gpt_infra/stack.py, the per-metric_name alarm loop). Metric key names below follow Dynatrace's usual cloud.aws.<namespace>.<metric> convention for AWS integration metrics; not confirmed against a real tenant, since the AWS integration is not connected (docs/proposals/dynatrace.md).

tiles.name: 403 loopback rejections
tiles.reliesOn: Approximate: the edge gateway's front door answers 403 for a request body containing a localhost or loopback URL before any WAF rule in this stack runs (README.md, Status), and nothing in the stack breaks that reason out from other 4xx responses. This counts every 4xx on the edge gateway as the closest available proxy; verify against gateway access logs, once those are enabled, before trusting the exact count.

queries.query:
fetch metrics
| filter metric.key == "cloud.aws.bedrock_agentcore.4xx_error"
| summarize sum(value), by: bin(timestamp, 1h)
